As long as any pane displaying a session remains mounted, the renderer instance is pinned visible and never evicted by LRU. - When a pane unmounts (e.g. background tab or detached pane), `registerVisible` cleanup unregisters the session. The instance enters the inactive LRU cache (`inactiveLruSessionIds`). - If the count of inactive renderers exceeds `warmCacheLimit` (configurable via `setWarmCacheLimit()`, defaulting to 2), the least-recently-used inactive instance is evicted. - **PTY Preservation**: Eviction disposes only frontend resources (`terminal`, `WebglAddon`, `SearchAddon`, `ResizeObserver`, DOM element, listeners). The backend PTY session, `backendSessionId`, and session record are never destroyed. 2. **Inactive Output Suspension & Safe Replay**: - When a session becomes inactive, its xterm output subscription is unsubscribed (`unsubscribeOutput()`) and any pending animation frame flush is cancelled. No background writes to xterm occur while inactive. - `TerminalEventBus` continues decoding incoming PTY chunks, updating OSC titles, and maintaining bounded backlog buffers. - Upon reactivation (becoming visible again), `terminal.reset()` clears stale xterm buffer state before re-subscribing with `attachScheduledOutputSubscription`, ensuring backlog replay cleanly precedes live output without duplicate or dropped lines. --- ### Verification - `bun run --cwd ui test -- terminalHostManager TerminalPane`: 13/13 tests pass. - `bun run --cwd ui build` (`tsc && vite build`): 0 TypeScript errors, bundle completed in 3.82s. - Pre-existing unrelated test failures in `src/state/workspaceStore.browserLifecycle.test.tsx` and `src/lib/browserTauri.test.ts` stem from native child webview mocks in untargeted test files and are untouched.
